For 0<δ<1, monotone-renewal-density Tauberian asymptotic and Dynkin–Lamperti give U~Beta(1−δ,δ), then independent V gives density and two beta integrals with coefficients as claimed. At δ=1, u(t)~1/log t and P(A_t≤t^v)→v transfer logarithmically to position and edge. Hypotheses are explicit and the arguments handle δ=1 and boundary moment equality; no infinite-mean stationary law is mistakenly asserted.
